name: capacitor-appodeal
description: Unofficial Appodeal Mediation Plugin for Capacitor
author: Israel Perales

scripts.verify: npm run verify:android && npm run verify:web
scripts.verify:android: cd android && ./gradlew clean build test && cd ..
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:android
scripts.test:web: tsc --module commonjs --target es2017 --sourceMap --outDir coverage/cjs && node --enable-source-maps --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info test/appodeal.test.cjs
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:web && npm run test:android
scripts.sonar: npm run test:coverage && npm run sonar:scan
scripts.sonar:scan: [ -f .env ] && set -a && . ./.env && set +a; docker run --rm --network host -u $(id -u):$(id -g) -v "$PWD:/usr/src:z" -e SONAR_HOST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9000 -e SONAR_TOKEN sonarsource/sonar-scanner-cli
scripts.sonar:issues: [ -f .env ] && set -a && . ./.env && set +a; curl -s -u "$SONAR_TOKEN:" "http://127.0.0.1:9000/api/issues/search?componentKeys=capacitor-appodeal&resolved=false&ps=500" | jq '.issues[] | {severity, type, message, file: .component, line}'
scripts.lint: npm run eslint && npm run prettier -- --check
scripts.fmt: npm run eslint -- --fix && npm run prettier -- --write
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && rollup -c rollup.config.mjs
